verdicts.title: Balanced Allocations in Batches: Simplified and Generalized
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider the allocation of m balls (jobs) into n bins (servers). In the Two-Choice process, for each of m sequentially arriving balls, two randomly chosen bins are sampled and the ball is placed in the least loaded bin. It is well-known that the maximum load is m/n + log2 logn + O(1) with high pr
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract of the cited paper discusses balanced allocations in batches and the maximum load, which does not relate to the conjecture about cumulative-entropy bounds in resolution proof complexity or Tseitin formulas. The specific claim Φ(π) >= c·|S|² is not addressed.
